name: Freeble

sources.title: Homepage — live directory of free online tools; 'Submit any listing for free' links to /create-freeble/
Acceptance Criteria — Explore listings must be free or ≥30-day trial, lesser-known, https, actively maintained; Quick Digest shows listings for 7 days

requirements: Tool must be completely free to use OR offer a minimum 30-day free trial
Should be 'lesser known' — obscure/new tools preferred over famous ones
Service must be actively offered; site URL must use https
Not accepted: blogs, YouTube channels, Chrome extensions, company listings
Quick Digest variant: free tool, https, displayed for only 7 days
preparation: Product name, https URL, description emphasizing the free tier/trial
Decide between the Explore listing (durable) or Quick Digest (7-day flash)
If the product is paid-with-trial, confirm the trial is ≥30 days before submitting
workflow: For a durable listing: use the 'Create' CTA → https://freeble.in/get-started-now/ (may require account creation)
Listings stay on Explore 'until their services/tools are free to use' — remove the free tier and the listing can be dropped
watchFor: No paid products without a real ≥30-day free trial — the free usage requirement is enforced
Quick Digest entries vanish after 7 days by design
Company listings (as opposed to individual tools) are explicitly rejected
Site is WordPress-based with light editorial; expect manual review
countsAsLive: The tool appears on freeble.in's Explore page (durable) or Quick Digest (7-day) with an outbound link
unknowns: Whether /get-started-now/ requires an account and its exact form fields
